verdict.rationale: Sardine has its own APIs: an async /businesses API with webhook events for KYB, and flexible APIs for ingesting transaction data. Its docs also list API references and SDKs. However, those references are 'protected documentation' that requires requesting sandbox access, so the API is not openly documented in public. A public llms.txt exists, but it covers guide content rather than an API reference. Missing for 10: openly accessible API reference documentation, evidence of full product coverage via API (much of the workflow is shown as dashboard-driven), authentication/endpoint details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
